attr.title: R36S Hardware Probe
attr.desc: Deep read-only R36S hardware and graphics-driver qualification suite. Inventories RK3326/Mali/DRM/kernel data and actively tests DRM, GBM, DMA-BUF, EGL, OpenGL ES, desktop OpenGL and Vulkan device creation.
attr.inst: Install with PortMaster and launch from Ports. Results are written to r36sprobe/reports/<timestamp>/.
